stem:
In each turn of a game, a coin is pushed and slides across a table. The distance, $X$ metres, travelled by the coin has probability density function given by

$$\text{f}(x) = \begin{cases} kx^2(2 - x) & 0 \leqslant x \leqslant 2, \\ 0 & \text{otherwise,} \end{cases}$$

where $k$ is a constant.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: State the greatest possible distance travelled by the coin in one turn.

parts.label: (iii)
parts.text: Find the mean distance travelled by the coin in one turn.

parts.label: (iv)
parts.text: Out of 400 turns, find the expected number of turns in which the distance travelled by the coin is less than 1 metre.
